```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(textstem)
library(rvest)
library(qdapRegex)
library(stopwords)
library(tidytext)
library(tokenizers)
library(e1071)
```

# Data Loading

```{r load_data}
# Load training data
load("../data/claims-raw.RData")
load("../data/claims-test.RData")
# Check dimensions
dim(claims_raw)
dim(claims_test)
```

# Preprocessing Functions

```{r preprocessing_fns}
# function to parse html and clean text (including headers)
parse_fn <- function(.html) {
  read_html(.html) %>%
    html_elements("p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6") %>%
    html_text2() %>%
    str_c(collapse = " ") %>%
    rm_url() %>%
    rm_email() %>%
    str_remove_all("'") %>%
    str_replace_all(paste(
      c(
        "\n",
        "[[:punct:]]",
        "nbsp",
        "[[:digit:]]",
        "[[:symbol:]]"
      ),
      collapse = "|"
    ), " ") %>%
    str_replace_all("([a-z])([A-Z])", "\\1 \\2") %>%
    tolower() %>%
    str_replace_all("\\s+", " ")
}

# function to apply to claims data
parse_data <- function(.df) {
  out <- .df %>%
    filter(str_detect(text_tmp, "<!")) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(text_clean = parse_fn(text_tmp)) %>%
    unnest(text_clean)
  return(out)
}

# Clean training data
claims_clean <- claims_raw %>%
  parse_data()

# Clean test data
claims_test_clean <- claims_test %>%
  parse_data()
```

# Feature Engineering (NLP)
```{r nlp_features}
# Tokenization and Lemmatization Function
get_tokens <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    unnest_tokens(
      output = token,
      input = text_clean,
      token = "words",
      stopwords = str_remove_all(stop_words$word, "[[:punct:]]")
    ) %>%
    mutate(token.lem = lemmatize_words(token)) %>%
    filter(str_length(token.lem) > 2)
}

train_tokens <- get_tokens(claims_clean)
test_tokens <- get_tokens(claims_test_clean)

# TF-IDF on TRAINING DATA
train_tfidf <- train_tokens %>%
  count(.id, token.lem, name = "n") %>%
  bind_tf_idf(token.lem, .id, n)

# Select Top 1000 Words
top_terms <- train_tokens %>%
  count(token.lem, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1000) %>%
  pull(token.lem)

# Pivot TRAIN matrix
train_features <- train_tfidf %>%
  filter(token.lem %in% top_terms) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = .id,
    names_from = token.lem,
    values_from = tf_idf,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  left_join(claims_clean %>% select(.id, bclass, mclass), by = ".id")

# Pivot TEST matrix
test_features_raw <- test_tokens %>%
  filter(token.lem %in% top_terms) %>%
  count(.id, token.lem, name = "n") %>%
  bind_tf_idf(token.lem, .id, n) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = .id,
    names_from = token.lem,
    values_from = tf_idf,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Ensure ALL training columns exist in test set
train_cols <- names(train_features %>% select(-bclass, -mclass))
test_cols  <- names(test_features_raw)

missing_cols <- setdiff(train_cols, test_cols)

for (col in missing_cols) {
  test_features_raw[[col]] <- 0
}

# Drop any extra columns test has that training does not
test_features_raw <- test_features_raw %>% select(all_of(train_cols))

# Ensure ALL test IDs appear (fixes missing rows)
all_test_ids <- claims_test_clean$.id

test_features <- tibble(.id = all_test_ids) %>%
  left_join(test_features_raw, by = ".id") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(., 0)))

# Align columns (add missing columns to test, remove extra)
missing_cols <- setdiff(names(train_features), names(test_features))
# Remove target columns from missing_cols
missing_cols <- setdiff(missing_cols, c("bclass", "mclass"))

for(col in missing_cols) {
  test_features[[col]] <- 0
}

# Ensure order
test_features <- test_features %>%
  select(all_of(names(train_features %>% select(-bclass, -mclass))))

# Handle NAs (if any id was dropped due to no tokens)
# We need to make sure all IDs in claims_test are in test_features
all_test_ids <- claims_test_clean$.id
test_features <- tibble(.id = all_test_ids) %>%
  left_join(test_features, by = ".id") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(., 0)))

```

```{r standardization}
# Standardization (Z-score)
# We need to scale the features. We'll use the training parameters to scale test data.
train_mat <- train_features %>% select(-.id, -bclass, -mclass) %>% as.matrix()
test_mat <- test_features %>% select(-.id) %>% as.matrix()

# Scale training data
train_scaled <- scale(train_mat)
train_center <- attr(train_scaled, "scaled:center")
train_scale <- attr(train_scaled, "scaled:scale")

# Scale test data using training parameters
test_scaled <- scale(test_mat, center = train_center, scale = train_scale)

# Handle constant columns (scale = 0) -> replace with 0
test_scaled[, train_scale == 0] <- 0
train_scaled[, train_scale == 0] <- 0

# Prepare dataframes for e1071
train_df_svm <- as.data.frame(train_scaled)
train_df_svm$bclass <- train_features$bclass
train_df_svm$mclass <- train_features$mclass

test_df_svm <- as.data.frame(test_scaled)
```

# Validation (Accuracy Estimation)

To estimate the accuracy of our models, we'll perform a simple 80/20 split on the training data.

```{r validation}
set.seed(123)
# Create split
split <- initial_split(train_df_svm, prop = 0.8, strata = bclass)
train_split <- training(split)
val_split <- testing(split)

# Binary Validation
svm_binary_val <- svm(bclass ~ ., data = train_split %>% select(-mclass), 
                      kernel = "linear", cost = 1)
binary_val_pred <- predict(svm_binary_val, val_split)
binary_acc <- mean(binary_val_pred == val_split$bclass)
cat("Estimated Binary Accuracy:", binary_acc, "\n")

# Multi-class Validation
svm_mclass_val <- svm(mclass ~ ., data = train_split %>% select(-bclass), 
                      kernel = "linear", cost = 1)
mclass_val_pred <- predict(svm_mclass_val, val_split)
mclass_acc <- mean(mclass_val_pred == val_split$mclass)
cat("Estimated Multi-class Accuracy:", mclass_acc, "\n")

# Summary of Model Performance
cat("\n=== Model Performance Summary ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Binary Classification Accuracy:      %.2f%%\n", binary_acc * 100))
cat(sprintf("Multi-class Classification Accuracy:  %.2f%%\n", mclass_acc * 100))
```

# Binary Classification (SVM)

```{r binary_svm}
set.seed(123)
library(e1071)

# Train SVM (Linear Kernel)
# type = "C-classification" for factor response
svm_binary <- svm(bclass ~ ., data = train_df_svm %>% select(-mclass), 
                  kernel = "linear", cost = 1, probability = TRUE)

# Predict
binary_pred_class <- predict(svm_binary, test_df_svm)
```

# Multi-class Classification (SVM)

```{r multiclass_svm}
set.seed(123)

# Train SVM (Linear Kernel)
svm_mclass <- svm(mclass ~ ., data = train_df_svm %>% select(-bclass), 
                  kernel = "linear", cost = 1, probability = TRUE)

# Predict
mclass_pred_class <- predict(svm_mclass, test_df_svm)
```

# Export Results

```{r export}
# Combine predictions
pred_df <- tibble(
  .id = test_features$.id,
  bclass.pred = binary_pred_class,
  mclass.pred = mclass_pred_class
)

# Save predictions
save(pred_df, file = "../results/preds-svm.RData")

# Save models
saveRDS(svm_binary, "../results/svm-binary.rds")
saveRDS(svm_mclass, "../results/svm-multiclass.rds")

cat("Predictions and models saved.\n")
```
